title: The Figure-Eight Lap and 'A Sister's Love'
summary: On Wednesday, February 11, 2015, at Star City General Hospital in Roanoke, Jordan completes his post-CABG Figure-Eight physical therapy lap and puts on The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel on his laptop—vocalizing the melody of Firelight's 'A Sister's Love' as the first major way he exercises his voice and takes longer, deeper breaths during recovery.
